questions.text: Which of the following phrases (A), (B), (C) given below the sentence should replace the phrase printed in bold to make the sentence grammatically correct? If the sentence is correct as it is, mark (D) as the answer. If the CEO **was aware of** the financial irregularities, he would have taken immediate action.
questions.solution: Shortcut: Identify the Conditional Type from the main clause ('would have taken' = Type 3 / Past Unreal). The 'if-clause' must then be Past Perfect ('had + V3'). Eliminate A (Simple Present), B (Simple Past/Subjunctive), and D. Only C ('had been aware of') matches the required Past Perfect structure. Step-by-step: 1) Main clause 'would have taken' signals Third Conditional (hypothetical past). 2) Rule: If + Past Perfect, ... would have + V3. 3) Bold part 'was aware' is Simple Past (Type 2). 4) Option C provides 'had been aware' (Past Perfect). Correct replacement is C.

questions.text: Rahul walks 10m North, turns right and walks 15m, turns left and walks 10m, turns right and walks 5m. Finally, he turns right and walks 20m. In which direction is he from the starting point?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Calculate Net Displacement (NS & EW). North: +10 +10 = +20. South: -20. Net NS = 0. East: +15 +5 = +20. West: 0. Net EW = 20m East. Final position is due East of start. Full Solution: Start (0,0). N10 -> (0,10). Right(E)15 -> (15,10). Left(N)10 -> (15,20). Right(E)5 -> (20,20). Right(S)20 -> (20,0). Relative to origin (0,0), final position (20,0) is exactly East.

questions.text: The average weight of 8 persons increases by 2.5 kg when a new person replaces one of them weighing 56 kg. What is the weight of the new person?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Total weight increase = Number of persons × Increase in average = 8 × 2.5 = 20 kg. This increase is solely due to the new person. Weight of new person = Weight of replaced person + Total increase = 56 + 20 = 76 kg. Full Method: Let original average be x kg. Total original weight = 8x. New average = (x + 2.5). Total new weight = 8(x + 2.5) = 8x + 20. Difference in total weight = 20 kg. This difference = (New Person Weight) - 56. So, New Person Weight = 56 + 20 = 76 kg.

questions.text: Statements: All pens are pencils. Some pencils are erasers. No eraser is a sharpener. Conclusions: I. Some pens are erasers. II. No pencil is a sharpener. III. Some pencils are not sharpeners. Which of the conclusions logically follow?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Use Venn diagram mental model. All pens ⊂ pencils. Some pencils ∩ erasers ≠ ∅. Erasers ∩ sharpeners = ∅. Conclusion I: Not necessary (pens may not be the pencils that are erasers). Conclusion II: Not necessary (pencils could be sharpeners except the eraser part). Conclusion III: Since some pencils are erasers and no eraser is sharpener, those pencils are not sharpeners → Some pencils are not sharpeners follows. So only III.

questions.text: Rearrange the following four sentences (P, Q, R, S) in the proper sequence to form a meaningful paragraph. P: However, the success of these policies hinges on effective implementation at the grassroots level. Q: The government has launched several ambitious schemes to boost rural employment. R: Without proper monitoring, funds often get diverted before reaching the intended beneficiaries. S: Therefore, a robust accountability mechanism is imperative for tangible results.
questions.solution: Shortcut/Trick: Find the opening sentence (independent, introduces topic). 'Q' introduces the subject (Government schemes). Look for mandatory pairs: 'However' in P contrasts Q (Q-P pair). 'Without...' in R gives a reason/counter-scenario following P. 'Therefore' in S concludes the argument (R-S pair). Sequence: Q -> P -> R -> S. Step-by-step: 1. Scan for starter: Q introduces 'schemes'. P, R, S start with connectors (However, Without, Therefore) - cannot start. 2. Q is first. 3. P follows Q (contrast via 'However'). 4. R follows P (elaborates failure mode 'Without monitoring'). 5. S concludes ('Therefore'). Order: QPRS.

questions.text: Read the sentence to find out whether there is any grammatical error in it. The error, if any, will be in one part of the sentence. The letter of that part is the answer. If there is no error, the answer is (D). (Ignore errors of punctuation, if any.) Neither the Minister nor his colleagues (A) / has given their consent (B) / to the proposed amendment (C) / No Error (D)

options.label: A
options.text: Neither the Minister nor his colleagues

questions.solution: Shortcut: Apply the Proximity Rule for 'Neither...Nor' — the verb agrees with the nearest subject ('colleagues', plural), so the verb must be plural ('have'). Scan the verb in Part B: 'has' is singular, creating a Subject-Verb Agreement error. The pronoun 'their' correctly matches the plural antecedent. Step-by-step: 1) Identify structure 'Neither A nor B'. 2) Verb agrees with B ('colleagues'). 3) 'Colleagues' requires plural verb 'have'. 4) Part B uses singular 'has' → Error in B.

questions.text: A train running at 72 km/h crosses a pole in 12 seconds and a platform in 28 seconds. What is the length of the platform?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Convert speed to m/s: 72 × (5/18) = 20 m/s. Length of Train = Speed × Time (pole) = 20 × 12 = 240 m. Length of (Train + Platform) = 20 × 28 = 560 m. Platform Length = 560 - 240 = 320 m. Full Method: Let train length be L, platform length be P. Speed = 72 km/h = 20 m/s. Crossing pole: L = 20 × 12 = 240 m. Crossing platform: L + P = 20 × 28 = 560 m. Subtracting: P = 560 - 240 = 320 m.

questions.text: A container contains 40 litres of pure milk. 4 litres of milk is taken out and replaced with water. This process is repeated two more times. What is the quantity of milk left in the container?
questions.solution: Shortcut (Formula): Final Quantity = Initial * (1 - Replaced/Total)^n = 40 * (1 - 4/40)^3 = 40 * (9/10)^3 = 40 * 729/1000 = 29.16 L. Full Method: After 1st replacement: Milk = 40 - 4 = 36 L (or 40 * 0.9). After 2nd: 36 * 0.9 = 32.4 L. After 3rd: 32.4 * 0.9 = 29.16 L.

questions.text: Select the option that best improves the underlined part of the sentence: 'Despite of his best efforts, he could not secure the desired rank.'
questions.solution: Shortcut: 'Despite' is a preposition that never takes 'of'; 'In spite of' is the correct three-word phrase. Eliminate any option that retains 'Despite of' or omits 'of' after 'In spite'. Step-by-step: 1) The original phrase 'Despite of' is incorrect. 2) Option A repeats the error. 3) Option B uses 'In spite' without 'of', making it ungrammatical. 4) Option D changes the meaning. 5) Option C 'Despite his best efforts' is grammatically correct and retains the intended meaning. Hence the answer is (C).

questions.text: In a certain puzzle, each letter stands for a distinct digit (0‑9) and the following addition is true: SEND + MORE ------ MONEY Which digit does the letter 'O' represent?
questions.solution: Shortcut: The only way for a 5‑digit sum to start with a new digit (M) is when there is a carry from the thousands column, so M = 1. Hence O must be 0 because the only remaining digit that can make the tens‑thousands column carry is 0. Full solution: 1) Since SEND + MORE = MONEY has 5 digits, M = 1. 2) Adding the thousands column: S + M (1) gives a carry of 1, so S must be 9 and O must be 0 to satisfy the equation O + carry = 10. Therefore O = 0, which is option A.

questions.text: In a certain code language: 'A + B' means 'A is the father of B' 'A - B' means 'A is the mother of B' 'A × B' means 'A is the brother of B' 'A ÷ B' means 'A is the sister of B' If the expression 'K + L - M × N ÷ O' is true, how is K related to O?
questions.solution: Shortcut (Generation Gap Method): Assign generation values: Father/Mother = +1; Brother/Sister = 0. Starting from K (+1 for '+') to L, then L to M (-1 for '-'), M to N (× = 0), N to O (÷ = 0). Net Gap = +2 (Grandparent level). Gender of K is Male (Father). The parental link to the 2nd generation is via Mother (L - M), so it is Maternal side. Answer: Maternal Grandfather. Full Solution: K + L → K is father of L. L - M → L is mother of M → K is maternal grandfather of M. M × N → M is brother of N → K is maternal grandfather of N. N ÷ O → N is sister of O → K is maternal grandfather of O.

questions.text: What is the unit digit of the expression (347)^102 + (653)^98?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Unit digit depends only on base unit digits (7 and 3). Cyclicity of 7 is 4 (7, 9, 3, 1). 102 mod 4 = 2 => Unit digit of 7^102 = 9. Cyclicity of 3 is 4 (3, 9, 7, 1). 98 mod 4 = 2 => Unit digit of 3^98 = 9. Sum = 9 + 9 = 18 => Unit digit 8. Full Method: 347^102 -> unit digit of 7^102. 7^1=7, 7^2=49(9), 7^3=343(3), 7^4=2401(1). Cycle 4. 102 = 4×25 + 2 => 2nd position = 9. 653^98 -> unit digit of 3^98. 3^1=3, 3^2=9, 3^3=27(7), 3^4=81(1). Cycle 4. 98 = 4×24 + 2 => 2nd position = 9. 9+9=18, unit digit 8.

questions.text: Fill in the blank: The _______ of the new airport is expected to boost tourism in the region. A) inauguration B) demolition C) renovation D) inspection
questions.solution: The correct answer is 'inauguration'. An inauguration marks the official opening of a new facility, which directly leads to an increase in tourism. 'Demolition' means destroying, which would reduce tourism. 'Renovation' implies fixing up an existing one, not necessarily a new airport's opening event. 'Inspection' is a routine check and does not signify the start of operations for a new airport.

questions.text: A is 40% more efficient than B. B alone can complete a work in 21 days. They start working together but after 5 days A leaves. In how many days will B finish the remaining work?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Efficiency ratio A:B = 140:100 = 7:5, so time ratio = 5:7; B takes 21 days (7 parts = 21, 1 part = 3), so A takes 15 days. Total work = LCM(15, 21) = 105 units. In 5 days, (A+B) complete 5×(7+5) = 60 units. Remaining 45 units done by B alone in 45/5 = 9 days.

questions.text: Statements: Only a few Pens are Pencils. All Pencils are Erasers. No Eraser is a Sharpener. Conclusions: I. Some Pens are not Sharpeners. II. All Pencils can never be Sharpeners.
questions.solution: Shortcut: 'Only a few A are B' = Some A are B + Some A are not B. 'All B are C, No C is D' => No B is D (Conclusion II follows). 'Some A are B, No B is D' => Some A are not D (Conclusion I follows). Both follow. Full Solution: From 'Only a few Pens are Pencils', some Pens are Pencils. From 'All Pencils are Erasers' and 'No Eraser is Sharpener', No Pencil is Sharpener (Conclusion II true). Since Some Pens are Pencils and No Pencil is Sharpener, Some Pens are not Sharpeners (Conclusion I true).
